title: Tech Collective LLC marketing site (pink & gold) with contact form and internal inquiries view

requirements.summary: Build a responsive single-page marketing website with header navigation to Hero, Services, About, and Contact sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page renders without errors and is usable on mobile and desktop.
Top navigation allows jumping to Hero, Services, About, and Contact sections.
Brand name “Tech Collective LLC” is visible in the header and hero.

file_operations.description: Create the main App shell that renders the marketing layout, including a responsive header with brand name “Tech Collective LLC” and anchor navigation links to #hero, #services, #about, and #contact sections.
Implement a responsive header with brand title and navigation links that jump to required sections; include mobile-friendly navigation behavior (e.g., collapsible menu).
Create a marketing page component that composes the Hero/Intro, Services, About, and Contact sections in the required order and ensures responsive spacing/typography.
Wire the MarketingPage into the app render flow so it is the default visible experience (no orphan views/components).

requirements.summary: Add a Services section that lists exactly four services with clear English descriptions in a responsive grid/cards layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Services section contains exactly the four services named by the user.
Each service has a short, readable description in English.
Services are presented in a clean layout (e.g., cards or a grid) and remain readable on mobile.

file_operations.description: Create the Services section that renders exactly these four offerings: Notarial services; Simple phone configuration & setup; Website creation; Tech consultations, each with a short English description and a responsive grid/card layout. Use shadcn-ui Card (or equivalent shadcn-ui primitives) to standardize spacing/typography; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add ServicesSection to the marketing page and ensure it is reachable via the #services anchor (and header navigation).

requirements.summary: Apply a consistent accessible pink-and-gold theme across typography, buttons, and section styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary accents use pink and gold consistently across header, buttons, and highlights.
Text contrast meets basic readability (no light text on light backgrounds).
Theme is applied consistently across all sections (no default/un-styled components).

file_operations.description: Add/define global styles and theme CSS variables for Tailwind/shadcn-ui tokens (e.g., --background/--foreground/--primary) tuned to a pink-and-gold palette with readable contrast, plus base typography defaults.
Extend Tailwind theme as needed to support the pink-and-gold design (e.g., custom named colors or token mapping) and ensure consistent usage across components/sections.

Apply consistent theme styling to header elements (links, buttons, focus states) so it matches the pink-and-gold brand and remains accessible (focus rings, contrast). Use shadcn-ui Button (or equivalent shadcn-ui primitives) where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure all sections share consistent padding, background treatments, headings, and button styling aligned with the pink-and-gold theme (no unstyled defaults).

requirements.summary: Add a Contact section with an inquiry form, basic validation, and a clear success confirmation state after submission.
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter contact details, select a service of interest, and submit a message.
After submit, the UI shows a success confirmation and clears or disables the form appropriately.
Form includes basic validation (required fields and valid email format when email is provided).

file_operations.description: Create the Contact section wrapper (anchored as #contact) that contains the inquiry form and a post-submit confirmation area styled to match the site theme.

Implement the inquiry form fields: name, email/phone (single contactInfo), service interested in (select), message; include basic client-side validation (required fields; validate email format when email is provided). Use shadcn-ui Input/Textarea/Select and Button for consistent form UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a React hook that calls the backend submitInquiry capability via the actor, manages loading/error/success state, and returns helpers to clear/disable the form on success.
Wire ContactSection (and its InquiryForm) into the marketing page and ensure it is reachable via the header navigation link to #contact.

requirements.summary: Add an internal “Inquiries” view/page in the frontend that fetches and displays stored inquiries in a readable list/table after authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores each inquiry with timestamp and submitted fields.
Frontend includes an “Inquiries” view/page that lists stored inquiries in a readable table/list.
Submitting a new inquiry makes it appear in the inquiries list after refresh/reload (or via refetch).

file_operations.description: Create an internal Inquiries page that fetches inquiries from the backend actor and displays them in a readable table/list (name, contactInfo, serviceInterested, message). Use shadcn-ui Table (or Card/list primitives) for clean presentation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a hook that fetches inquiries (getAllInquiries) via the actor with loading/error handling and a refetch mechanism after a new inquiry is submitted.

Add a lightweight auth gate using the authorization component pattern: require Internet Identity login before showing internal data; show an access-denied/please-login state otherwise. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an admin-only gate for the Inquiries view using backend role checks (e.g., isCallerAdmin/getCallerUserRole) and display an access denied state when not authorized. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a Login/Logout button using the authorization component guidance (Internet Identity). Ensure logout clears cached app data (react-query cache) for internal views. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire navigation to the Inquiries page (e.g., a header link/button) and ensure the Inquiries page is not orphaned. Keep the public marketing content accessible without login; only gate the internal inquiries view.
After successful submission, trigger inquiries refetch behavior when applicable (e.g., if the internal inquiries view is open) while still showing a clear success confirmation in the contact section.

requirements.summary: Render generated pink-and-gold brand imagery (logo, hero background, service icons sprite) from static frontend assets in header/hero/services.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI.
Header displays the logo and hero section uses the hero image tastefully without harming readability.
Images load correctly in production build and do not require backend calls.

file_operations.description: Render the static logo image from frontend/public/assets/generated/tech-collective-logo.dim_512x512.png in the header alongside the brand name, ensuring it scales well on mobile/desktop.

Create a hero/intro section (anchored as #hero) that uses the static hero background image from frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png with an overlay/treatment to preserve text readability and meet contrast requirements.

Wire the service icons sprite from frontend/public/assets/generated/service-icons-sprite.dim_512x128.png into the services UI (e.g., per-service icon display) while keeping layout readable and responsive.
Include the HeroSection at the top of the marketing page and ensure both hero imagery and logo are visible in the overall layout without requiring any backend calls.
